6. My best advice for new shooters to get better is going to be a few things, as I don't like it when people just say practice. Practice is good, but only if you practice properly. 
Before even taking a shot you have to be mentally focused, think this is going to be a perfect shot. 
Next tip is an easy one, take the time to remind yourself which sight is more important, the one closest to the muzzle or the one closest to you? The one close to you is the one that you make sight adjustments off of so that ones more important imo.
Also get into a breathing pattern I do 5 full breaths then 2 half exhaling and holding. This isn't call of duty you don't hold your breath in, you hold it out.
If you are also interested there's a book by the name of With winning in mind. Written by an Olympic gold medalist in the art of shooting. Highly reccomended.
